title.zh: Bank of Korea launches 24-hour won settlement pilot for foreign investors
title.en: Bank of Korea launches 24-hour won settlement pilot for foreign investors

current_state.zh: The Bank of Korea launched a pilot 24-hour won settlement network with four domestic banks to let foreign investors settle KRW transactions during their home-country business hours, with full operations planned for January 2027.
current_state.en: The Bank of Korea launched a pilot 24-hour won settlement network with four domestic banks to let foreign investors settle KRW transactions during their home-country business hours, with full operations planned for January 2027.
